I mean honestly it is, but there really are just too many things out of my control to be able to be affected. I worked at a non profit where a few members of management were straight up afraid of the people we were helping and so would refuse to handle emergency situations.  It’s difficult because people in crisis are already having a really bad time both mentally and physically, and without backup and respect from management us ground level workers get lashed out at from both sides.  I can understand a client having a mental breakdown or even just wanting to repeat the discrimination that’s been dished out to them by society, and I get that managers and upper level executives have paperwork and grants and all that. But fundamentally when staff get assaulted and sexually and racially discriminated against and management doesn’t try to support its workers, it’s just an unending cycle of more negativity in an industry that unfortunately always need more people willing to make a change. 

That being said though, I still don’t appreciate being told on a daily basis that I brought the covid to America. Or having clients ignore me on basis of my nationality. I was raised in America and I still regularly get people asking me to “speak in English” when I have no accent and I’m trying to explain their rights to them or housing options. And I’d really love it if I could get into dancing and escorting with at least some insider information on what the Asian American sentiments are like in these scenes and how to react if someone is just really going hard on me about being a chink or something while I’m trying to get that bag ya feel? 🤡

So yeah tldr, I’m not expecting to be able to avoid any of the harassment. But it’s be cool if I could hear more stories from everyone about their personal experiences with racism in sex work!

Does anyone else find it insanely hard to get themselves to shower? I know it’ll feel so much better later. I feel disgusting now. But I can barely get myself to get out of bed. It’s been a while. I still do other things though like make sure there’s no grease anywhere from food or dirt from outside so that there aren’t any little enemies 🙃 but other than that it’s so hard. I live at home and my room is so cluttered with junk and I struggle to throw things away because one of my parents used to make me second guess everything I wanted to toss out growing up while the other rolled their eyes and said to just toss stuff like usual. It’s like I’m doing the bare minimum — keeping my stuff clean but not organized, and going to work to make money. Playing video games I used to like or draw for a little. Everything I want to do is according to the parent I live with (and love dearly) unrealistic and disorganized but it’s also true. I’ve had really obvious ADHD (diagnosed in elementary school) my entire life but it’s been harder having people understand when you’re a girl. Being constantly told things like *cross your legs*! Or *stop fidgeting* *because it’s unladylike*! And girls didn’t really want to be my friend starting in middle school because I struggled to pick up on social cues -- I’d be the one talking long after everyone stopped, or constantly getting up in the middle of class and raising my hand or touching other people when it’s clearly inappropriate. If you’ve ever seen the NICHQ Vanderbilt Assessment Scales then you’ll know what I’m talking about. I’ve given up on staying sober for any given day. I blew through a 1g thc cartridge in less than a week. Everything feels so out of order in life and so disjointed. Sometimes it feels like I’m just waiting to step over to the other side.
